title: InterPresure Q&A
description: A single pragmatic-goal question posed to an AI model, its answer, and a pass/fail/na verdict with severity and confidence scores.

question.description: The pragmatic-goal question posed to the model.

answer.description: The model's answer to the question.

model.description: Identifier of the AI model that produced the answer (e.g. 'gpt-4o', 'claude-3-7-sonnet').

reasoning.description: Optional chain-of-thought or explanation produced by the model before reaching its answer.

result.description: Whether the pragmatic goal was achieved (pass), not achieved (fail), or not directly assessable by this question and requires human judgment (na).

severity.description: For fail: severity of the issue (0 = trivial, 10 = critical). For na: importance for human review. For pass: should be 0.

confidence.description: Model's self-reported confidence in its answer, 0-100.
